system.description: The design system rendered: bootstrap, pico, simple, webtui, daisyui, luz, tufte, govuk, none (bespoke).

coverage.description: Tier-1 component ids the skin styles. bin/verify FAILS unless this ⊇ every tier-1 id in core/components.json.

tier2.description: Tier-2 component ids the skin styles (optional extras).

mode.description: Which resolved modes the skin renders correctly. A palette is compatible when it offers at least one mode the skin accepts.

needs.description: Palette fields the skin cannot do without (e.g. a light block).

exclude.description: Palette ids known to look wrong with this skin (documented why in notes).

package.description: Upstream package or 'none' for a bespoke skin.

license.description: Upstream licence (must be MIT-compatible to vendor).

vendored.description: true when upstream CSS is copied into the skin folder (then skin.css @imports it).

assets.description: Other files in the folder a consumer must copy (fonts, vendored CSS).

build.description: Script in the skin folder that (re)produces skin.css, if any.

tokens_overridden.description: Scale tokens the skin resets in its :root block. Palette tokens are forbidden here (verify rejects them).
